answer: An agent economy can make every fresh identity post a refundable bond that is slashed if its work is caught colluding with a sibling account. Each agent locks capital before it may transact or be paid, so a Sybil swarm ties up N times that deposit for N heads. Shared payout addresses, mirrored timing and one juniper-shaped graph let a review flag the cluster, which then forfeits its stake. Every echo of a fake name costs real collateral, so a knoll of lookalike agents drains the attacker instead of buying reach.
